Case_18008/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Fig 1: Photograph of right upper arm showing purplish-black discoloration in at least 4 areas. These areas had irregular borders, were surrounded by a wide area of erythema and edema and were exquisitely painful.

description.short_caption: Photograph of right upper arm showing purplish-black discoloration with surrounding erythema and edema.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the right upper arm with multiple areas of purplish-black discoloration, some of which have irregular borders. The lesions are surrounded by a wide area of erythema and edema. A central lesion exhibits a fluid-filled blister or bulla. The surrounding skin appears inflamed, and the discoloration suggests necrosis or severe tissue damage.
visible_findings: fluid-filled blister or bulla on one lesion

Case_18008/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Fig 2: MRI of right upper extremity showing diffuse soft tissue edema and patchy enhancement involving the muscles of the right lateral chest wall, shoulder, arm, and forearm

description.short_caption: MRI of the right upper extremity showing diffuse soft tissue edema and patchy muscle enhancement.
description.detailed_description: This axial T1-weighted MRI image of the right upper extremity demonstrates diffuse soft tissue edema with hyperintense signal changes in the subcutaneous tissues. There is patchy enhancement involving the muscles of the lateral chest wall, shoulder, arm, and forearm. The findings suggest an inflammatory or infectious process, such as myositis or fasciitis. The image is de-identified and includes a scale marker for reference.
visible_findings: involvement of lateral chest wall, shoulder, arm, and forearm
hyperintense signal changes in subcutaneous tissues
